reason: The prose answer gives the correct aqueous MDEA CO₂-scrubbing equation, with correct connectivity, stoichiometry, atom balance, and charges. However, the Lean theorem proves only that a hard-coded equation is atom/charge balanced; it does not establish that this is the reaction specified by the problem, and its Species model omits molecular connectivity. The default project build also fails because IChO2026Problems/All.lean is missing.

coverage.evidence: PDF page 64 and T7_page-2.png depict HO–CH₂CH₂–N(CH₃)–CH₂CH₂–OH in aqueous solution removing CO₂. The submitted equation CH₃N(CH₂CH₂OH)₂ + CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ [CH₃NH(CH₂CH₂OH)₂]⁺ + HCO₃⁻ is scientifically correct and balanced. Lean verifies C₆H₁₅NO₅ and zero net charge on both sides, but IsBalanced reactionEquation is only a necessary balance check on a definition containing the answer; it neither states nor proves a reaction-selection relation connecting the source chemistry to those products.

unsupported_assumptions: The formal development silently assumes that the hard-coded reactionEquation is the actual aqueous MDEA/CO₂ reaction; no Lean-encoded chemistry law or source-linked proposition establishes that product selection.

The Lean Species structure records only elemental counts and charge, so the molecular connectivity distinguishing MDEA and protonated MDEA is present only in untrusted names/comments, not in the theorem statement.
source_checks: TASK.json was read first; its SHA-256 values match theory_problem.pdf, T7_page-1.png, and T7_page-2.png.

Direct inspection of T7_page-1.png confirms CO₂ enters scrubber Z with N₂ and H₂; T7_page-2.png and original PDF page 64 confirm compound 3 has one methyl and two 2-hydroxyethyl substituents on tertiary nitrogen.
Original PDF page 69 (A7-3) was inspected and contains a blank 7.4 response box with no fallback equation or extra condition.

Independent ordinary-chemistry checking confirms that aqueous tertiary amines such as MDEA yield protonated amine and bicarbonate; see the primary research discussion in [Processes 7, 81](https://www.mdpi.com/2227-9717/7/2/81) and the cited MDEA study at [Wiley](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/kin.20375). No official solution or answer repository was consulted.
The submitted molecular formulas give reactant and product totals C₆H₁₅NO₅, with charges 0 on each side; no stereochemical issue is present.
proof_checks: Printed axiom dependencies are only propext and Quot.sound, both standard Lean axioms.
No sorry, admit, unsafe, native_decide, or custom axiom declaration was found in the relevant Lean sources.

reaction_conserved_totals and t7_a4_reaction_equation genuinely prove atom and charge balance by reduction and norm_num, without false premises, but do not prove chemical product selection or molecular connectivity.
The default lake build fails because IChO2026Problems.lean imports the absent IChO2026Problems/All.lean, so the supplied project is not cleanly buildable as its declared default target.
